fieldNotes.addressCorrection: Roster address (3601 Brighton Blvd) is wrong — that point falls in the redeveloped RiNo district of central Denver with no industrial facility. The real Frito-Lay Denver plant & warehouse is at 3995 Nome St / 11645 E 37th Ave, Denver CO 80239 (Montbello/Gateway), coords 39.77066,-104.85292. Confirmed via web search and satellite.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View of the south side shows a chain-link sliding gate across a truck driveway with a STOP sign and a posted sign reading 'GATE 8' — a numbered, controlled truck entry. The entire property is enclosed by chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed on multiple SV faces).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No full guard-booth structure visible at the truck gate; a small kiosk-style box sits beside the sliding gate, consistent with remote/badge or call-box check-in rather than a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no staffed booth -> remote check-in (kiosk/badge/call-box). Gate numbering ('Gate 8') confirms a managed multi-gate site.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate building faces (south/west dock line plus an east dock line), each fronting its own fenced trailer yard.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large multi-row trailer drop yards on the west and east sides of the plant — well over 50 trailers; ~180 visible.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail yard runs along the south edge of the property with a spur reaching the site.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least one numbered gate confirmed ('Gate 8'); numbering implies multiple gates around the fenced perimeter — estimated 2.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated ~38 acres from the perimeter box covering the plant, both trailer yards, and office parking.
